tablesMenu.Name: Harvest tables
tablesMenu.Label: Edit the harvest tables
tablesMenu.Hint: The components each creature type gives, and tables of their own for particular creatures, each with its DC and marks (E, E+, V), the book's notes on harvesting each type, and random components (the ooze's d100 table). Type them in, paste rows copied from the book, or import a JSON file.

rulesMenu.Name: Harvest rules
rulesMenu.Label: Edit the harvest rules
rulesMenu.Hint: The skill for each creature type and whether it can be ritual carved, the harvest time and most helpers for each size, the essences by challenge rating, and what components sell for. Starts with the book's numbers.

playersCanHarvest.Name: Players can harvest
playersCanHarvest.Hint: Players can open the harvest window for a beaten monster (from the chat card's Harvest button, the Harvest tool in the Token controls, or the keybinding) and make the harvest themselves. Their changes to the monster's token and to inventories are made by the GM's client, so a GM must be logged in.

deadOnly.Name: Only beaten creatures can be harvested
deadOnly.Hint: A creature can be harvested once it's at 0 hit points, has the Dead status, or is marked defeated in the combat tracker. The GM can always harvest.

offerInChat.Name: Offer harvesting in chat
offerInChat.Hint: Post a card with a Harvest button for each beaten monster: once when a combat ends (all of its beaten monsters on one card), or each time a monster drops to 0 hit points.

addItems.Name: Put harvested components in an inventory
addItems.Hint: The components harvested are added as loot items (Material) to the character picked in the harvest window, stacking with ones harvested before. A component linked to an item in the harvest tables gives that item.

advanceTime.Name: Pass the harvest time on the game clock
advanceTime.Hint: After a harvest, move the world time on by how long it took (15 minutes for a Medium creature, by the book).

shareWindow.Name: Share the harvest window
shareWindow.Hint: When anyone opens a harvest window, it opens for every player who can harvest and for the GM, and every change (the harvest list, who assesses, carves and helps, who gets the components) shows on every screen. Changes are made by the GM's client, so a GM must be logged in.

requireApproval.Name: The GM approves each harvest
requireApproval.Hint: Players can roll a harvest only once the GM has approved it in the shared harvest window. A player changing the harvest list, or who assesses, carves or helps, withdraws the approval. The GM can always roll. (Needs the shared harvest window.)

splash.Name: Show the harvest splash
splash.Hint: When a harvest is rolled, show a screen with the checks, the total and the components harvested (after Dice So Nice's dice land).

showRollDialogs.Name: Show dnd5e's roll windows
showRollDialogs.Hint: Show dnd5e's roll window (advantage, disadvantage, situational bonus) for the assessment and carving checks. When off, both are rolled at once. This is your own choice.

HarvestTarget.Hint: Open the harvest window for the creature you're targeting (or a monster you control).

Tables.Title: Harvest Tables
Tables.TypeHint: Every creature of this type gives these, unless it has a creature table of its own.
Tables.Name: Component
Tables.TagsHint: E (edible), E+ (edible and used in crafting), V (volatile), * (see note), ** (monster-forged only)
Tables.DropHint: Drop an item here to give it instead of a plain component.
Tables.DropOnlyItems: Only items can be dropped here.
Tables.NoRows: No components yet. Add rows, or paste them from the book.
Tables.PasteHint: One component per line: its DC, its name and its marks, in any order (Eye 5 E, or 10 Heart E+). Lines without a DC, such as headings, are left out.
Tables.ImportHint: Pick a JSON file from Foundry's files or from this computer, or paste JSON. Merging replaces the tables in it and keeps the rest; replacing empties every table first. Nothing is kept until you press Save.
Tables.ImportDone: Imported {types} type tables and {creatures} creature tables ({components} components). Press Save to keep them.
Tables.DiscardText: Close without saving your changes to the harvest tables?
Tables.ImportFoundryHint: A .json file in Foundry's Data folder
Tables.TableNoteHint: The book's rules for harvesting this table's creatures (shown in the harvest window)
Tables.RandomHint: A table rolled once for each corpse of this type, whose results can then be harvested: one row per line, its numbers, then the component and (in brackets) the creature type it came from, whose table gives its DC. "Nothing" gives nothing; "Roll twice more" rolls again. A DC can be written in (DC 10). The die is the highest number.
Tables.RandomNoDC: No DC found for: {names}. Add a DC to the line (DC 10), or the component to its type's table.
Tables.Essences: Essences, for every creature type: each corpse also offers the essence of its challenge rating in the harvest window. {list}.

Rules.Title: Harvest Rules
Rules.Hint: The harvest rules of Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting. Change them to match your book or your table.
Rules.RitualHint: Ritual: the carver can use their spellcasting ability instead of Dexterity.
Rules.Both: One creature making both checks rolls both with disadvantage
Rules.ResetText: Put every number back to the book's? Your changes are lost when you save.
Rules.PricePerDC: Other components sell for (gp per DC)
Rules.PricePerDCHint: A component's sell price is its DC (the one on its table, not its running harvest DC) times this. 0 for no prices.
